name: real-material-mechanism-screen-2026-10-20
claim: A history-grounded physical state and, if necessary, a state-dependent material evolution law improve held-condition prediction beyond fixed-spectrum/static/QLV explanations; real-feedback action value is a separate claim.
unit_of_analysis: reset-to-recovery episode for pilot; specimen/day clusters for independent confirmation

splits.name: preload-amplitude
splits.held_out: all high-terminal-preload episodes; both technical repeats
splits.leakage_check: entire episodes; report achieved-strain overlap from the common probe

splits.name: waiting
splits.held_out: all middle-wait episodes; interpolation, both repeats
splits.leakage_check: fit repeat 1 and validate repeat 2 only outside held condition

splits.name: history-program
splits.leakage_check: no future-force selection of histories or preprocessing

splits.name: independent-confirmation
splits.held_out: new specimens/day and frozen new duration/order program
splits.leakage_check: freeze candidate and comparison before collection; new day and specimen partly crossed

baselines.name: S2/S4/S6
baselines.category: nonlinear equilibrium stiffness with fixed spectrum

metrics.name: held-condition recontact force RMSE in N
metrics.rationale: primary constitutive mechanism test, compared against repeatability and calibration sensitivity

metrics.name: recontact peak error and threshold contact position error
metrics.rationale: links recovery to subsequent interaction and geometry; fixed threshold sensitivity reported

metrics.name: later future-command force and actual-motion prediction
metrics.rationale: separate actuator and material contributions; never condition on future measured motion

metrics.name: later meaningful task completion time and completion rate
metrics.rationale: same feedback/control; practical thresholds frozen from measured task/noise/latency before action tests

ablations: 2/4/6 fixed modes and static versus QLV nonlinearity
constant versus state-dependent rate with same state dimension
frozen law x current/history initialization factorial after mechanism screening
calibration perturbation and actual-motion versus command-conditioned prediction
actual measured feedback retained; no artificial feedback removal as main evidence
falsification_criteria: Strong classical models reach repeatability/calibration scale and the rate candidate has no independent benefit: retain classical law.
Benefits vanish on new specimen/day/program: narrow claim, do not proceed to flexible learning.
Residual explained by synchronization, actuator, interface or irreversibility: model that cause rather than an ungrounded rate.
Prediction gain persists but action gain is below measured practical threshold: report mechanism/prediction contribution only.
pilot_inference_limit: Two technical repeats on one specimen; no population p-values, no timestamp bootstrap.
practical_thresholds: Numerical values deliberately pending measured calibration/pretest; no inherited simulated thresholds.
two_level_validation: First laws and future-command prediction; then matched closed-loop action. Material law and initial state contributions separated.
